prompts.connect: – workflow: run authored Axiom workflows and skills
prompts.instructions: workflow is active. Each command's summary says what it does. workflow libs and lib serve the reference libs, each loaded once per agent: skip a lib whose marker is already in your context. Details: metaform help workflow.
prompts.execution: Axiom is interpreted by the agent reading this subroutine. Its content and bound arguments are supplied unchanged. Follow its conditions, routing, loops, Retry, Catch and verification. Your saved variables are provided beside it. Use workflow call for a same-agent subroutine call, and workflow handoff where the authored call requires a fresh agent. Supply this call's run id, , and your current variables. For authored Parallel, workflow parallel takes the independent calls and returns their handoff run ids; the caller resumes when every branch has returned. Use workflow complete with the subroutine's RETURN expression and final variables to deliver its result. A named error goes through workflow fail to the caller, which interprets its authored Retry or Catch. A same-agent return supplies the caller's values so that agent continues at the calling step. A fresh-agent return supplies only its caller's run id: give it back to the caller or orchestrator. The caller resumes its run and continues its own Axiom.
prompts.paused: Run waits for the person. End your turn; whoever resumes the run reads their answer with metaform workflow resume run=.
prompts.paused_note: Workflow run waits for you: Answer with metaform workflow answer run= <your answer>.
prompts.answered: Tell its agent: metaform dispatch message -- "Run is answered; resume it with metaform workflow resume run="
prompts.answered_alone: Resume it with metaform workflow resume run=, or give that line to the agent carrying the run.
prompts.handoff: Give run to a fresh agent. It resumes the run with metaform workflow resume run= --project on the CLI or workflow_resume with run over MCP and receives its subroutine and bound values.
prompts.assignment: When your YIELD is complete, run `metaform workflow complete run= --project `, or over MCP call `workflow_complete` with run .
prompts.assignment_answer: <<DATA: The person's answer>> What stopped this run: Their answer: <<END DATA>>
